moral_character_required.quote: An individual is not eligible for registration as a professional engineer or certification as an engineering intern if the individual has been convicted of: (1) an act which would constitute grounds for disciplinary sanction under IC 25-1-11 ; or (2) a felony that has a direct bearing on the individual's ability to practice competently.

exams.name: Engineering Fundamentals
exams.notes: First part of the two-part examination; tests mathematics and physical and engineering sciences. Applicants holding an engineering intern certificate from Indiana or equivalent state may be exempted.
exams.quote: An applicant shall have three (3) attempts to pass each part of the examination within a time period established by the board by rule.

exams.name: Principles and Practice of Engineering
exams.notes: Second part of the two-part examination; tests understanding and application of engineering sciences and design. Must pass Engineering Fundamentals first.
exams.quote: An applicant shall have three (3) attempts to pass each part of the examination within a time period established by the board by rule.

interval_years.quote: expires biennially after the initial expiration date

required.quote: The board may adopt rules requiring a professional engineer to obtain continuing education for renewal of a certificate under section 17 of this chapter.

available.quote: The board may, upon application and payment of a fee established by the board in the board's rules, issue a certificate of registration as a professional engineer to an individual who holds a valid certificate of registration as a professional engineer, issued to the applicant by the proper authority of any state or territory or possession of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid certificate of registration from another state/territory/possession with requirements not conflicting with Indiana's; board may accept NCEES verified professional record. Reduced experience requirement if applicant has at least 3 years post-graduation experience and has been licensed in another state for at least 10 years.
requirements.quote: the board may accept the verified professional record of the applicant that is certified by the National Council of Examiners for Engineers and Surveyors

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of registration, upon the payment of the fee prescribed by the board under IC 25-1-8-2 ... to any applicant who, in the opinion of the board, has satisfactorily met all requirements of this chapter. In the case of a professional engineer, the certificate shall authorize the practice of "professional engineering".

disciplinary_grounds.description: Stamping or sealing any document with a seal after the certificate of the registrant named on the seal has expired or been revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for any person to stamp or seal any document with a seal after the certificate of the registrant named on the seal has expired or has been revoked.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of engineering" means any service or creative work that the adequate performance of requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to services or creative work that includes the following: (1) Consultation. (2) Investigation. (3) Evaluation. (4) Planning, including planning the use of land and water. (5) The design of or the supervision of the design of engineering works and systems. (6) Engineering surveys and studies... (7) Evaluation of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with specifications, plans, and designs...

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineering intern" means an individual who: ... has been issued by the board an appropriate certificate of enrollment as an engineering intern.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: An applicant who holds a degree of doctor of philosophy or the equivalent thereof from a curriculum in engineering approved by the board may be given a maximum of credit of two (2) years of experience in addition to a credit of four (4) years of education.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: have been in responsible charge of engineering work or engineering teaching for at least five (5) years.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: A business, including a proprietorship, partnership, or corporation, doing business in Indiana may not practice or offer to practice engineering unless that practice is carried on under the responsible direction and supervision of a registered professional engineer who is a full-time employee of the business.
